Treat hosted extraction output as an independently tested producer contract. A declared primary variable may still be absent while raw speech and administrative fields are emitted. Inspect the saved structured extractor response and count primary-field coverage before attributing the failure to confidence, a missing schema field, or bank infrastructure. Keep the primary scalar description concise, with a single coherent grammar, phase-specific meanings, exact matching decoder examples and no sibling-variable envelope instructions. A bounded validation retry may repair format, but is not permission to salvage missing financial consent from raw speech. Test the actual normalized published schema as well as the controller. Raw neutral identity facts require bank comparison; missing financial primary acts require bounded clarification and remain non-authoritative.
Reconcile aggregate monetary amounts in exact minor units or decimal arithmetic derived from the API precision. Binary floating-point equality must not reject a valid fractional total. On a verified non-transfer format-exhaustion completion, discharge the supplied policy's mandatory product-note obligations through successful receipts before final closure, preserving already recorded promises and unresolved service-error dispositions. Never add notes on a transfer path or turn malformed proposals into payment/refusal authority.
